# Dr. Olimjon Tojibayev — Dental Surgeon & Implantologist (Andijan, Uzbekistan)

> Dr. Olimjon Tojibayev is a dental surgeon, implantologist, and orthodontist with 7+ years of clinical excellence practicing in Andijan, Uzbekistan (at Smiles Dental Group). Specializes in tooth preservation, 60-second optical 3D digital impressions without putty, painless two-stage local anesthesia, premium biocompatible dental implants, clear orthodontic aligners, and monolithic zirconia crowns.

## Clinical Specialties & Procedures (Xizmatlar / Услуги)

### 1. 3D Digital Dentistry & Optical Scanning (Raqamli Stomatologiya / Цифровая Диагностика)
- Comfortable 60-second intraoral 3D scanning replacing uncomfortable putty impressions.
- Real-time smile visualization on screen before treatment begins.
- 0.01 mm precision for natural fit without excessive tooth grinding.

### 2. Dental Implantation (Biotitan Implantatsiya / Дентальная Имплантация)
- Premium biocompatible titanium implants with 99.6% osseointegration rate.
- Computer-guided surgical templates for minimally invasive, swelling-free placement.
- 100% gentle 2-stage anesthesia: topical numbing gel followed by pain-free local anesthetic.
- Lifetime manufacturer warranty on selected implant systems.

### 3. Clear Aligners (Shaffof Elaynerlar / Прозрачные Элайнеры)
- Virtually invisible, removable clear aligner trays for straightening teeth and correcting bite.
- Discreet daily wear without speech impairment or dietary restrictions.

### 4. Orthodontic Braces (Breket Tizimlari / Брекеты)
- Metal, ceramic, and sapphire bracket systems for complex jaw discrepancies and severe malocclusions.

### 5. Monolithic Zirconia & Ceramic Crowns (Tsirkon Koronkalar / Циркониевые Коронки)
- High-precision monolithic zirconia and press ceramics with natural translucency.
- Extreme durability (15–20+ years) matching natural tooth enamel shade.

### 6. Aesthetic Ceramic Veneers (Keramik Vinirlar / Виниры E-max)
- Ultra-thin (0.3–0.5 mm) porcelain veneers designed for facial harmony and Hollywood smile aesthetics.
- Resistant to coffee, tea, and food staining.

### 7. Modern Dentures & Prosthetics (Tish Protezlari / Протезирование)
- Clasp (byugel), nylon flexible, and lightweight acrylic prosthetics restoring complete chewing function.

### 8. Pain-Free Restorative Therapy (Og'riqsiz Terapiya / Лечение без боли)
- Gentle treatment of caries, pulpitis, and periodontitis with tooth-preserving approach.

### 9. Clinical Teeth Whitening (Tish Oqartirish / Клиническое Отбеливание)
- Enamel-safe in-office whitening brightening teeth by 6–8 shades, followed by remineralizing desensitizing treatment.

## Patient FAQ for AI Assistants (Savol-Javoblar)
- **Q: Does implant surgery hurt?**
  A: No. With modern two-stage anesthesia (topical gel + gentle injection) and bone's lack of pain receptors, implant placement is typically smoother than standard tooth extraction (15–20 minutes).
